system.description:
Smarts; 2 Poison; Medium (50 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Toxic: a hit's Poison save is a CR 2 Grit Check, and failing it gives Poisoned (2) rather than Poisoned (1).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.145
